note: Both sets cover the same core claims and both repeat the generator-torque negative-damping fact twice (claims 1 and 10 in A, 1 and 11 in B). Set B additionally captures the important page fact that the aerodynamic power sensitivity ∂P/∂θ to rotor-collective blade pitch is negative in Region 3 for an active pitch-to-feather turbine, which Set A omits entirely. All other claims in both sets are correctly bound, conditioned and quoted, so the deciding factor is B's extra correct claim versus A's missing one.
remarks: Both sets state the generator-torque controller negative damping twice under slightly different attribute names ('damping effect on speed error response' vs 'effect on speed error response') — a deduplication issue in both extractions. Neither set extracts the PI gain expressions (Eqs. 7-14, 7-15) or the definitions of ωφn and ζφ (Eqs. 7-12, 7-13), though those may be outside the sampled claims.
